info.title: PortFinder API
info.description:
Look up where a device is connected on the network. Query Cisco IOS-XE telemetry data by MAC address or IP address to find the switch port, VLAN, and interface details. Accepts multiple terms per request and supports colon, hyphen, Cisco dot, and bare hex MAC formats (all case-insensitive).

**Authentication:** API requests are authenticated either by your browser SAML session (when calling from this docs page) or by a personal access token sent as `Authorization: Bearer pfk_...`. Generate and manage tokens on the [API Tokens](/tokens) page. Tokens let scripts and applications call the API without dealing with SAML cookies.

post.summary: Search by MAC or IP address
post.description:
Returns all matching rows from the telemetry database. Each term is classified as a MAC address or IP address and looked up accordingly. A single request may mix MACs and IPs.

**Accepted MAC formats** (all case-insensitive):
- Colon-separated: `aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff`
- Hyphen-separated: `aa-bb-cc-dd-ee-ff`
- Cisco dot notation: `aabb.ccdd.eeff`
- Bare hex: `aabbccddeeff`

200.description: Matching telemetry records. Returns an empty array when no matches are found.

400.description: Request body is not valid JSON.

401.description: Bearer token is invalid, expired, or revoked.

get.summary: Reverse DNS lookup for an IP address
get.description: Resolves an IPv4 address to a hostname via a reverse DNS (PTR) lookup. Returns the first hostname found with the trailing dot removed. The lookup times out after 3 seconds; on timeout, lookup failure, or when no PTR record exists, the response is still `200` with `hostname` set to `null`.

200.description: Lookup completed. `hostname` is null when the address has no PTR record or the lookup failed/timed out.

400.description: The `ip` parameter is missing or is not a valid IPv4 address.

401.description: Bearer token is invalid, expired, or revoked.

bearerAuth.description: Personal access token generated on the /tokens page (format: pfk_...). Alternative to the SAML browser session.

terms.description: MAC addresses and/or IP addresses to look up.

node_id.description: Device hostname or ID reported by the telemetry stream.

mac_address.description: MAC address as stored by the device.

ip_address.description: IP address from the ARP table. Null if no ARP entry exists for this MAC.

interface.description: Full interface name (e.g. GigabitEthernet1/0/1). Null when the MAC has not yet appeared in the MAC address table.

access_vlan.description: Access (data) VLAN configured on the interface. Null when no interface configuration is available.

voice_vlan.description: Voice VLAN configured on the interface. Null when no voice VLAN is configured.

hostname.description: Hostname from the PTR record (trailing dot removed), or null when the lookup found nothing.
